title: PWM
text: Generate ideal pulse width modulated signal corresponding to input duty cycle, 1 input, 1 output, no direct feedthrough, {Disallow zero duty cycle} sets Avoid algebraic loops off; {Period (s)} sets the pulse width, {Initial Delay}, {Run at fixed time intervals} selects for discrete time behavior and {Sample Time} sets the pulse resolution. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Run at fixed time intervals
params.values: Select for discrete time behavior on (default) | off
